title: FEMA Request for Information - Direct Housing Modernization Capabilities
description: This Request for Information (RFI) is for Market Research purposes ONLY. Please read the notice and attachment in full. Please limit questions to those directly related to the posted RFI Notice and the information requested therein. Questions submitted in response to this RFI Notice may not receive a response. Questions outside the scope of this notice, including matters unrelated to the stated capability requirements, will not receive a response. The Government will consider only questions that are directly relevant to the notice and the requested capability information. If responses are provided, relevant questions and Government responses, if any, will be posted to Sam.gov ONLY after the Request for Information Notice has closed. RFI RESPONSE SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS: Interested contractors shall submit Questions and RFI responses electronically to the Contracting Officer, at Rachel.Woods@fema.dhs.gov no later than 12:00PM Eastern Time (ET), December 18, 2026. Phone calls will not be accepted. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulations Overhaul (RFO) 15.101(c). This RFI does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response to this request. All information contained in this RFI is preliminary and is subject to change if, and when, a solicitation is issued. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the U.S. Government to form a binding contract. If a competitive solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this RFI, or future solicitations. The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, Office of Direct Housing Operations, is conducting market research to identify and seek capabilities from industry in five primary functional areas: Automated Real Estate Aggregation and Vacancy Sourcing - Automated discovery and ingestion of residential rental property listings via Multiple Listing Services (MLS), property management software APIs, commercial rental boards, and direct landlord entry portals. - Real-time vacancy validation to prevent matching against obsolete or unavailable listings. - Rapid geo-fencing within disaster-declared zones and surrounding reasonable-commute perimeters. Artificial Intelligence and Algorithmic Matching - Multi-constraint matching algorithms that pair applicant household profiles with available properties in seconds. - Multi-point geospatial proximity optimization factoring in school district retention, work commutes, medical/provider travel distance, and essential services. - Household composition sizing aligned with HUD Housing Quality Standards (HQS) and FEMA occupancy guidelines. Automated Physical Accessibility Verification - Algorithmic filtering and computer vision inspection tools capable of evaluating floor plans, entry photos, and property specifications against UFAS and ADA physical accessibility standards. - Rapid identification of barrier-free environments, ramps, ground-floor units, grab bars, and wheelchair-accessible kitchens and bathrooms. Landlord Engagement and Leasing Workflow Automation - Automated outreach tools and self-service portals for landlords to submit properties, accept lease terms, and coordinate inspections. - Integration with standard government lease templates and automated electronic signature workflows. Secure Federal Architecture - Enterprise data security architecture compliant with the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) at the Moderate impact baseline. - FedRAMP-authorized cloud hosting (or capability to achieve FedRAMP Moderate/High authorization). - Strict data protection for Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) belonging to disaster survivors. NAICS CODE: 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services) / 531210 (Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers) PRODUCT SERVICE CODE (PSC): X1FA, Lease/Rental of Family Housing Facilities ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE START DATE: TBD RFI RESPONSE SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS: Interested contractors shall submit Questions and RFI responses electronically to the Contracting Officer, at Rachel.Woods@fema.dhs.gov no later than 12:00PM Eastern Time (ET), December 18, 2026. Phone calls will not be accepted. Please see the attachment for further instructions and information.

title: France – Advertising and marketing services – Achats d'espaces sur les médias offline pour ARTE France
description: Le présent marché est un accord-cadre mono-attributaire à bons de commandes, ayant pour objet, à titre non exclusif sur le territoire de la France et, de façon très exceptionnelle et ponctuelle, dans d'autres pays de l'Union européenne, l'achat d'espaces publicitaires sur tous les supports publicitaires dits offline (affichage, cinéma, radio, presse, TV). Des accords sont également conclus entre les principaux constructeurs TV (Samsung et LG) et ARTE GEIE pour centraliser les négociations à l'échelle européenne. ARTE France peut également acheter de l'espace en direct avec certaines régies pour des raisons éditoriales. Il est par ailleurs indiqué que les besoins d'ARTE pour l'achat d'espace sur le digital et les réseaux sociaux sont déjà couverts dans le cadre d'un autre marché et sont donc exclus du périmètre du présent marché. Il est précisé que l'accord-cadre sera conclu sans minimum et avec un maximum de 16 Meuros HT (seize millions d'euros hors taxes) sur toute la durée de l'accord-cadre (4 ans maximum). Il est en outre précisé que ce montant maximum ne constitue pas une indication du budget d'ARTE France mais bien le plafond maximal que l'accord-cadre ne pourra pas dépasser sur la durée maximale du marché, soit 4 (quatre) ans.

description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. As part of the Army�s continuous transformation effort, initiatives are being implemented to transform how the Army operates, trains, and equips for C2 capabilities that enhance its lethality, mobility, and survivability in large-scale combat as part of the Joint Force. The result is data-centric C2 at every echelon that can operate in any environment. NGC2 requirements are currently being informed by persistent experimentation. Market research and prototyping will create a competitive environment for innovative industry partnerships and continuous integration of new technologies. Un pôle « conservation » regroupant des fonctions : de bibliothèque-étude des collections, de zone tampon, d'atelier de restauration comprenant des fonctions d'atelier d'analyse-catalogage, d'atelier d'encadrement, d'atelier de numérisation, de stockage. - Un pôle « réserves et logistique collections » regroupant des fonctions : de réception-départ des oeuvres, d'emballage-déballage et constats, de quarantaine, de dépôt principal-fonds classiques, d'armoires réfrigérées pour fonds spécifiques. - Un pôle « technique et exploitation » regroupant des fonctions : de PC sécurité, d'atelier technique et dépôt dont stockage, de vestiaires-sanitaires, de local ménage, de local déchets, de local chaufferie, de local TGBT, de local ventilation, de local serveur informatique / GTB. - title: Norway – Secondary education services – Evaluation of testing of the subject Research Teaching with the recess assignment 2027-2028 (2029).
description: The school year 2027-2028, Udir is carrying out an experiment with a new voluntary programme subject on the education programme for study specialisation for students at sixth form colleges. The subject 'research teaching with the recess assignment' (hereafter called FF) aims at preparing pupils for further studies. The subject has content and skills that are not necessarily covered in other disciplines, but which are particularly relevant for higher education. Examples of such content are: method knowledge, basic science theory, research ethics and ethical and appropriate use of artificial intelligence. See the experimental curriculum in the subject here Experimental curriculum: Research teaching with in-depth assignment, vg3 (FLF03 01) and information on the trial here: Trial with new optional programme subject on vg3. The pupils shall have an on-going assessment, on the same basis as other disciplines. As a part of the ongoing assessment, the pupils shall, in the first half of the training, carry out, among other things, two obligatory pupil works that shall be assessed by the teacher. Each pupil shall, in addition, submit a recess assignment with a problem connected to the pupil ́s other programme subjects at sixth form colleges. The in-depth assignment is in writing and it shall be assessed by a teacher and another teacher. The recess assignment, with subsequent assignment discussions, shall form the main basis for the stance assessment, although other assessment work shall also be included in the assessment documentation. Teaching aids are not specifically prepared for this subject.

title: Finland – Graphic design services – OPH Oppimateriaalien vähälevikkisten suomen- ja ruotsinkielisten perusopetuksen tai toisen asteen oppimateriaalien graafinen suunnittelu ja taitto
description: Hankinnan kohteena on OPH Oppimateriaalien suomen- ja ruotsinkielisten perusopetuksen tai toisen asteen oppimateriaalien graafisen suunnittelun ja taiton palvelu. Tämä hankinta koskee ainoastaan Opetushallituksen Oppimateriaalit ja julkaisut -yksikön oppimateriaalien graafista suunnittelua ja taittoa. Opetushallituksen yleinen graafista suunnittelua ja taittoa koskeva sopimus kilpailutetaan erikseen. Opetushallitus (jäljempänä OPH) on kansallinen koulutuksen, kielen ja kansainvälistymisen asiantuntija, kehittäjä ja palveluntuottaja. OPH Oppimateriaalit on OPH:n oppimateriaalikustantamo, joka täydentää kaupallisten kustantamojen valikoimaa ja kustantaa oppimateriaaleja pienille kohderyhmille. Oppimateriaaleja tehdään eri kouluasteille (perusopetus, toinen aste) ja hyvin monenlaisille oppijoille (mm. oppimisen tuki, harvinaiset kielet, katsomusaineet ja eri ammattialat) sekä suomeksi että ruotsiksi. OPH Oppimateriaalit sijoittuu viraston Oppimateriaalit ja julkaisut -yksikköön. Oppimateriaalit ja julkaisut -yksikössä ei työskentele graafisia suunnittelijoita, joten graafiset palvelut hankitaan ostopalveluna. Yksikkö hankkii esimerkiksi painettujen kirjojen ulkoasun suunnittelua ja taittoa sekä pdf-tiedostoina jaettavien lisämateriaalien taittoa. Ostopalveluna hankitaan myös oppimateriaalien uusintapainoskorjaukset sekä markkinointiesitteiden ja muun markkinointimateriaalin suunnittelu ja toteutus. Lisäksi ostopalveluna hankitaan digimateriaalien kannet, ikonit ja bannerit sekä graafiset esitykset ja kartat. Hankittavat palvelut on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1. ”Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Hankinta on jaettu kahteen (2) osa-alueeseen: Osa-alue 1: Matematiikan sekä matemaattisten ja teknisten aineiden oppimateriaalien graafinen suunnittelu ja taitto Osa-alue 2: Muiden kuin matematiikan sekä matemaattisten ja teknisten aineiden oppimateriaalien graafinen suunnittelu ja taitto Tarjoajan on liitettävä tarjoukseensa osa-alueen 1 osalta seuraavat täydennetyt liitteet: - Liite 3.1. Hintalomake (osa-alue 1) - Liite 4.1. Tarjoajan referenssilomake (osa-alue 1) - Liite 5.1. Asiantuntijan referenssilomake (osa-alue 1) - Liite 6. Alihankkijat (mikäli tarjoaja käyttää alihankkijoita palvelun tuottamisessa) Tarjoajan on liitettävä tarjoukseensa osa-alueen 2 osalta seuraavat täydennetyt liitteet: - Liite 3.2. Hintalomake (osa-alue 2) - Liite 4.2. Tarjoajan referenssilomake (osa-alue 2) - Liite 5.2. Asiantuntijan referenssilomake (osa-alue 2) - Liite 6. Alihankkijat (mikäli tarjoaja käyttää alihankkijoita palvelun tuottamisessa) Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen jompaankumpaan tai molempiin osa-alueisiin. Hankintamenettelynä on puitejärjestely. Molempiin osa-alueisiin valitaan enintään viisi (5) Toimittajaa, jotka asetetaan ranking-järjestykseen tarjouspyynnössä ilmoitettujen tarjousten vertailuperusteiden mukaisesti. Tarjoajan on mahdollista sijoittua ranking-listalle molemmissa osa-alueissa. On myös mahdollista, että sama Tarjoaja sijoittuu ranking-listalle useammin kuin kerran. Rinnakkaistarjoukset ovat sallittuja asiantuntijakohtaisesti. Tarjoaja voi siten jättää useamman tarjouksen, mikäli Tarjoajalla on tarjota useampaa kuin yhtä asiantuntijaa. Esimerkiksi: Tarjoajalla on tarjota kolme (3) eri asiantuntijaa osa-alueeseen 1. Tarjoaja tekee kolme (3) tarjousta, yksi (1) tarjous / asiantuntija. Tarjoajan asiantuntijat sijoittuvat tarjousten vertailussa sijoille 1,3 ja 5. Samat sijoitukset pätevät myös ranking-listalla. Ranking-listan mukaisesti tilaukset tehdään ensisijaisesti ensimmäiseksi tulleelta Tarjoajalta (tässä tilanteessa Tarjoajan ensimmäiseksi tulleelta asiantuntijalta). Puitejärjestelyssä ranking-listoille sijoittuneiden Toimittajien kanssa solmitaan hankintasopimukset, jotka astuvat voimaan mahdollisimman pian hankintapäätöksen saatua lainvoiman.

title: Romania – Software-related services – Servicii de dezvoltare a soluțiilor digitale integrate și instruirea personalului și a utilizatorilor în cadrul proiectului „Dezvoltarea digitală în cadrul parteneriatului între Comuna Mugeni și Comuna Feliceni”
description: Achiziția publică vizează servicii privind dezvoltarea, integrarea, testarea, punerea în funcțiune și pilotarea a 7 soluții digitale — digitalizarea serviciilor publice oferite de UAT, comunicarea bidirecțională cu cetățenii, optimizarea fluxurilor interne ale primăriei, platforma de educare și conștientizare, asistența prin chatbot bazat pe inteligență artificială, sistemul de raportare și analiză (Business Intelligence) și modulul de optimizare a consumului energetic — livrate ca ecosistem digital integrat, pe o arhitectură modulară comună, cu izolarea datelor fiecărui UAT. Achiziția include instruirea personalului și a utilizatorilor, predarea licențelor/drepturilor de utilizare aferente soluțiilor dezvoltate, garanția și suportul tehnic (minimum 24, maximum 48 de luni) și mentenanța software (minimum 36, maximum 60 de luni), ambele calculate de la data recepției finale și incluse în prețul ofertat, conform secțiunii 7.9 din caietul de sarcini. Nu fac obiectul prezentei proceduri echipamentele hardware necesare testării și pilotării, achiziționate distinct. Obiectiv general Obiectivul general al proiectului îl reprezintă modernizarea serviciilor publice furnizate de administrațiile locale ale Comunei Mugeni și Comunei Feliceni, prin implementarea unui ansamblu de 7 soluții digitale integrate, în vederea digitalizării proceselor administrative, a îmbunătățirii comunicării cu cetățenii și mediul de afaceri și a creșterii eficienței interne a celor două primării. Obiective specifice - OBS1 — Dezvoltarea și implementarea celor 7 soluții digitale integrate, ca ansamblu funcțional, pilotat și recepționat în ambele UAT-uri; - OBS2 — Digitalizarea proceselor administrative prin fluxuri automatizate (minimum 3 fluxuri de lucru administrative automatizate); - OBS3 — Implicarea cetățenilor prin bugetare participativă (platformă care permite implicarea a minimum 677 de cetățeni, cumulat pe durata proiectului); - OBS4 — Promovarea accesibilității și educației digitale (minimum 700 de utilizatori unici; minimum 2 sesiuni de instruire pentru cetățeni și reprezentanți ai companiilor, organizate de beneficiar, cu suportul furnizorului — platformă, materiale și asistență tehnică; instruirea prestată de furnizor vizează exclusiv personalul celor două primării: minimum 2 sesiuni, minimum 10 ore, conform secțiunilor 7.8 și 11.6 din caietul de sarcini); - OBS5 — Reducerea timpilor de răspuns administrativ (de la ~7 zile la 48 de ore); - OBS6 — Creșterea eficienței energetice și a sustenabilității, prin modulul de monitorizare și optimizare a consumului energetic. Țintele obiectivelor specifice reprezintă cerințe minime ale caietului de sarcini; propunerea de valori superioare nu se punctează, evaluarea ofertelor realizându-se exclusiv pe baza factorilor de evaluare prevăzuți la secțiunea II.2.5. Număr de zile până la care se pot solicita clarificări înainte de data-limită de depunere a ofertelor: 15 zile. În măsura în care solicitările de clarificări au fost adresate în termenul precizat în documentație, termenul de răspuns al autorității contractante este de 10 zile înainte de data-limită de depunere a ofertelor. Orice solicitare de clarificări trebuie transmisă în SEAP (http://sicap-prod.e-licitatie.ro/pub).

title: Poland – System and support services – Usługa asysty technicznej witryny funduszeue.slaskie.pl wraz z rozbudową i modyfikacją portalu funduszeUE.slaskie.pl oraz CMS (modyfikacja funkcjonalności, nowe funkcjonalności) w ramach roboczogodzin programistycznych
description: 1. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest prowadzenie asysty technicznej witryny funduszeue.slaskie.pl wraz z rozbudową i modyfikacją portalu funduszeUE.slaskie.pl oraz CMS (modyfikacja funkcjonalności, nowe funkcjonalności) w ramach roboczogodzin programistycznych. Przedmiot zamówienia obejmuje rozwój, modyfikację oraz utrzymanie istniejącego portalu funduszeUE.slaskie.pl oraz systemu CMS, funkcjonujących w środowisku technologicznym Zamawiającego. Zamówienie nie obejmuje wymiany systemu CMS ani zmiany głównego stosu technologicznego (backend, baza danych), chyba że Zamawiający wyrazi na to pisemną zgodę. Zamówienie obejmuje następujące działania: a) Działanie I – obejmujące świadczenie przez Wykonawcę usługi asysty technicznej (wsparcia) przez okres do 34 miesięcy; b) Działanie II – (w tym prawo opcji) – rozbudowa i modyfikacja portalu funduszeUE.slaskie.pl oraz CMS (modyfikacja funkcjonalności, nowe funkcjonalności) w ramach roboczogodzin programistycznych, w tym: • 50 roboczogodzin w zamówieniu podstawowym, • 350 roboczogodzin w prawie opcji. Wykonawca zobowiązany jest do realizacji przedmiotu zamówienia zgodnie z zasadą „nie czyń poważnych szkód” (Do No Significant Harm – DNSH), o której mowa w art. 17 rozporządzenia Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2020/852 oraz zasadami horyzontalnymi wynikającymi z rozporządzenia (UE) 2021/1060. Zamawiający wskazuje, iż przedmiot zamówienia ma charakter usługowy i nieinwestycyjny, o znikomym wpływie na środowisko. W związku z tym spełnienie zasady DNSH zapewniane jest poprzez sposób organizacji i realizacji usługi, w szczególności poprzez rozwiązania organizacyjne i techniczne ograniczające negatywny wpływ na środowisko. Wykonawca zobowiązuje się do realizacji zamówienia w pierwszej kolejności z wykorzystaniem narzędzi cyfrowych, w tym do: • przekazywania dokumentów i raportów w formie elektronicznej, • ograniczenia drukowania materiałów do niezbędnego minimum, • stosowania komunikacji elektronicznej w realizacji zamówienia. 2. Zamawiający, w trakcie trwania postępowania o udzielenie zamówienia publicznego, przewiduje możliwość udostępnienia posiadanej dokumentacji oraz kodu źródłowego posiadanego narzędzia CMS zainteresowanym Wykonawcom, w ustalonym terminie, celem sprawdzenia dokumentów niezbędnych do realizacji zamówienia, dostępnych na miejscu u Zamawiającego, na podstawie art. 131 ust. 2 pkt 2) ustawy Pzp, zgodnie z zapisami pkt 12 Opisu Przedmiotu Zamówienia (OPZ) – (Załącznik nr 3 do SWZ). 3. Zamawiający uprawniony jest do skorzystania z prawa opcji, o którym mowa w art. 441 ust. 1 ustawy Pzp, na zasadach opisanych w paragrafie 2 i 6 załącznika nr 2 do SWZ - projektowanych postanowieniach umowy. 4. Opis przedmiotu zamówienia (w skrócie: OPZ) stanowi: Załącznik nr 3 do SWZ / Załącznik nr 1 do projektowanych postanowień umowy. 5. Projektowane postanowienia umowy w sprawie powyższego zamówienia publicznego, które zostaną wprowadzone do treści umowy znajdują się w Załączniku nr 2 do SWZ.

title: Finland – Unmanned aerial vehicles – Micro-UAS Procurement v2
description: The Finnish Border Guard (later also Contracting Authority) is launching a restricted procurement procedure for the procurement of small unmanned aircraft systems (hereinafter referred to as the UAS) and is inviting suppliers to request participation. This Request for Participation alongside its appendices sets out general requirements for the unmanned aircraft system (hereinafter referred to as the system) and the unmanned aircraft (hereinafter referred to as the UAV) to be procured. More detailed requirements will be presented in the Call for Tenders, which will be published later. The Finnish Border Guard's unmanned aviation is civil aviation that complies with the provisions of the Aviation Act (864/2014) and Traficom OPS M1-35 State Unmanned Aviation. The operations may deviate from the EASA drone regulations, taking into account the flight safety definitions of the 'specific' category. In addition, the operations of unmanned aircraft comply with the provisions and instructions of the Border Guard's permanent documents. The Finnish Border Guard uses unmanned aerial vehicles to perform statutory tasks on land and at sea. Unmanned aerial vehicles may be used in crime prevention, maritime rescue, special forces operations or in support of other authorities, for example in the search for a missing person. Unmanned aerial vehicles may also be used in other operational tasks as well as in research, development, education, training and communication activities. Interested candidates are requested to attach brochures of the proposed systems in their request to participate. If the product in the brochure does not meet the requirements stated in this Request for Participation, the participant may be excluded from the tendering phase. After submitting the tenders, the Finnish Border Guard may request tenderers to submit a test version of the proposed UAS to verify the requirements set out in the Call for Tenders. The total estimated value of this procurement is 450 000 €.

title: Norway – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Procurement of a digital learning platform for the defence sector.
description: The defence sector is currently using the Moodle Workplace learning platform. The learning platform is used to carry out digital learning on unclassifed platforms (Internet), both as remote learning and physically in classrooms. The learning platform is integrated, or is planned to be, with several central systems in The Norwegian Armed Forces. The reason for the procurement is the need for a modern LMS solution that meets the organization’s need for training and competence. The Norwegian Armed Forces need to procure an overall Learning Management System (LMS), delivered as a SaaS service on the Internet. The procurement shall include access to the LMS system itself, accompanying operation and management, as well as the necessary services for implementation, adaptation, further development and support. The need also includes consultancy services concerning technical configuration, integrations with the agency's other systems and development assignments. Beyond this, there will be a need to facilitate the use of artificial intelligence for the production of digital learning content and analysis. The goal of the procurement is to ensure a stable, secure and cost efficient operation, management and further development of the learning platform for the defence sector, so that the system always supports the agency's need for learning and competence development. This shall be done by procuring and developing an overall SaaS based LMS system that ensures a long-term and effective training. This is to support the Chief of Defense's plan from the year of 2020. The system must offer a high availability, performance and security, and the platform shall be further developed in line with changing organizational, pedagogical, and technological needs. Please read the procurement documents for further details on the procurement, including its extent.

title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [AI-as-OS] Artificial Intelligence as Operating System
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) methods have been expanding into new areas of application for years. AI systems are increasingly capable of handling complex tasks with greater autonomy—for example, through agent-based approaches that run an AI agent on a computer to perform any task automatically or even autonomously, sometimes without explicit human instructions but rather based on identified intentions (see, for example, the open-source software OpenClaw, which can handle tasks such as calendar maintenance or file management). Just how deeply AI algorithms and models are now integrated into everyday applications is also evident in the fact that end devices are increasingly operable entirely without visible applications and exclusively via voice control, which fundamentally rethinks the way we interact with them (such as Deutsche Telekom’s AI Phone). The central control units of such end devices—the operating systems themselves—are also increasingly being enhanced with new AI functionalities to continuously improve system efficiency. These include initial theoretical—and in some cases already practical—approaches to using the latest AI technologies for file system or storage management. These developments mark a fundamental paradigm shift: AI is no longer viewed merely as an add-on, but increasingly as a native architectural component of the operating system itself. The AI-as-OS program aims to explore how artificial intelligence can be understood not merely as a separately encapsulated functionality that is simply executed by the operating system, but as the operating system itself—Artificial Intelligence as Operating System. Behind this lies the vision of an AI that not only supports individual applications but also acts as the central control system for the entire computer ecosystem, managing system resources (including the CPU, RAM, and system security) in a data-driven, adaptive, and context-aware manner. The aim of the program is to make fundamental contributions to the development of AI-based operating systems as the control unit of a computer system. Through the extensive integration of AI technologies into deep operating system layers, such a system is intended to manage system resources, enable context-aware operational decisions, and enhance system security through adaptive threat detection and defense. Since the underlying technology is still largely in a speculative stage, the scope of development work ranges from the general architecture of such an operating system to the integration of AI-based core mechanisms, and includes new considerations regarding the security and stability requirements for such an operating system, depending on the target platform (e.g., desktop, data center, edge device) and the application environment. The program’s main areas of research include: • AI-Centric Operating System Architectures: Concepts for the fundamental design of an operating system in which AI is viewed not as an add-on feature but as an integral part of the architecture. • AI-Native Core Mechanisms: Integration of AI-based methods into core operating system functions such as resource management, process control, and memory organization. • Control, Security, and Stability: Requirements for traceability, controllability, and robustness of an AI-based operating system, as well as approaches to adaptive threat detection and defense. From today’s perspective, it remains to be seen whether—and to what extent—the vision of an AI-native operating system can be technically realized. This is precisely where the program’s value lies: AI-as-OS explores a largely speculative field at the intersection of AI research and system software, the results of which could set the course for the operating systems of tomorrow.

title: Germany – World wide web (www) site design services – uestra.de Vertragsausschreibung für Hosting, Support & Weiterentwicklung
description: Die ÜSTRA Hannoversche Verkehrsbetriebe Aktiengesellschaft beabsichtigt mit der Beauftragung, die Übernahme, den Betrieb, die technische Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der aktuellen ÜSTRA Website (uestra.de) unter Beibehaltung der Kernsysteme der bestehenden Dienstleister (Bewerbungsmanagement/ Fundsachen/ Beschwerdemanagement/ Fahrtauskunft etc.). Im Rahmen einer gemeinsamen Marke ist uestra.de damit auch die digitale Visitenkarte des ÜSTRA Verbunds und der regiobus GmbH. Der Internetauftritt gilt als zentraler Baustein der digitalen Kundenkommunikation. Ziel ist es, die Struktur und das Design der Website technisch auf dem aktuellen Stand zu halten. Perspektivisch soll es keinen Relaunch im klassischen Sinn – mit dem Erstellen einer komplett neuen Website – geben, sondern die derzeitige stetig weiterentwickelt werden. Zukünftig ist zudem eine technische Anbindung an externe Systeme wie bspw. eine CRM-Datenbank, ein textbasiertes Dialogsystem (Chat-Bot/ Wissensdatenbank) und ein Managementsystem für Veranstaltungstickets geplant. Diese externen Systeme sind kein Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung, deren Anbindung an die Website muss aber mitgedacht und –geplant werden. Um zukunftsfähig zu bleiben, muss die Website auch weiterhin für SEO und moderne KI-Anforderungen (GEO) technisch und inhaltlich ausgerichtet sein/ werden. Auf allen relevanten (Unter-) Seiten sind strukturierte Daten nach schema.org zu implementieren. Zudem soll eine Weiterentwicklung auch im Hinblick auf die Nutzung von KI umgesetzt werden. Denkbar wäre die Anbindung von Copilot an das Typo3 System, um Unterseiten und/ oder Texte auf uestra.de über die KI mittels eines Prompts erstellen zu lassen. Die ÜSTRA Website ist eine Mobilitätsplattform, die (potenzielle) Kund*innen, Kooperationspartner*innen sowie weitere Stakeholder durch die Vielzahl von Möglichkeiten des ÖPNV navigiert. Aktuell umfasst sie neben dem Online-Ticketshop die digitale Fahrtauskunft und diverse Angebote und Services rund um die Mobilität (u.a. sprintRad, Online-Fundbüro, Pünktlichkeitsgarantie, etc.). Zudem ist sie die digitale Visitenkarte des Unternehmen ÜSTRA, die auch im Rahmen der Investor Relations alle notwendigen Informationen vorhält. Darüber hinaus bietet das Karriereportal einen Onlineeinstieg in die Arbeitswelt der ÜSTRA und regiobus. Die ausgeschriebene Leistung umfasst daher die Wartung, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Website mittels des marktüblichen Content-Management-Systems TYPO3 einschließlich der Anbindung an die Umsysteme über einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren mit der Option einer viermaligen Verlängerung um ein Jahr. Hinzu kommt das Hosting der Seite und des Servers für das Monitoring via Matomo über die Vertragsdauer und eine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Seite, um auf aktuelle Veränderungen und Neuerungen im Netz reagieren zu können. Bei der Website wird besonderer Wert auf eine zeitgemäße und nutzerfreundliche Oberfläche mit Fokus auf der mobilen Ansicht und zusätzlichem Bewegtbild-Content gelegt. Eine Einbindung von Videos muss über Social Media Plattformen (embed-Variante) wie bspw. YouTube, aber auch direkt über das Dateimanagementsystem der Website möglich sein. Die ÜSTRA benötigt während der gesamten Leistungserbringung einmal jährlich Usabilitytests in Bezug auf die Kundenbedürfnisse und zur Qualitätssicherung der Website. Da bestehende Funktionalitäten regelmäßig überprüft werden sollen sind hier entsprechende Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten. Für die Abstimmung während der Vertragslaufzeit sollen auf Wunsch der ÜSTRA auch Vor-Ort-Termine in Hannover stattfinden. Sowohl der Support als auch die Absprachen im Projektteam müssen auf Deutsch mit einem C-Niveau stattfinden.

description: The contract will comprise the procurement of a suitable co-extrusion film blowing line and on-site installation thereof. The Sustainable Chemistry & Technology group within Wageningen Food & Biobased Research conducts application focused (contract) research, aiming to develop chemicals, polymers, and plastic products with a particular focus on improving sustainability aspects to help decrease the environmental burden related to plastics. The developed materials are typically recycled, biobased, biodegradable, or combine multiple of these approaches. A key element in such development projects is processing plastic granulates into products, using processing methods such as sheet extrusion, film casting, film blowing, injection moulding, thermoforming, hot pressing, etc. This type of work requires equipment to be very flexible in terms of materials, processing conditions, and volumes. The currently operational film blowing line is an example of such a piece of equipment. With this line, we can produce multilayer films at a scale large enough to get insights that are relevant for scaling up a formulation to a commercial production process, but small enough to require a manageable amount of materials (range ~15 kg/h – 50 kg/h). to the extent that the budget allows for, the offered line should provide the opportunity to produce multilayer cast films. It is acceptable to use the existing 200 mm die and 230 mm wide take-off line as downstream equipment for cast film production. It is also acceptable to include all devices required for multilayer cast film production within the tender.

buyer: Agentur für Innovation in der Cybersicherheit GmbH
title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [Ne-Trust] Negative Trust Architectures
description: IT systems face an increasing threat from insiders - individuals who often move through systems undetected, exploring IT infrastructure and causing damage. The growing awareness of this attack vector is further amplified by the use of artificial intelligence (AI). These current and future challenges also extend to the realms of public administration, defense, and security agencies. To be prepared for such threat scenarios, IT security paradigms are of critical importance: they shape the fundamental ways in which IT systems are designed, operated, and protected. "Zero Trust" is the most well-established example; however, as a countermeasure against insider threats, this approach has its limitations. Key foundational documents, such as the NIST SP 800-207 guideline, point to remaining gaps and areas that require further research. Against this backdrop, there is a need to explore an advanced, novel paradigm for more effectively defending against insiders. The goal of "Ne-Trust" is to enable demonstrably better detection and more proactive defense against the evolving and increasingly complex insider threats to IT systems, thereby advancing beyond the Zero Trust model. The program is built upon the innovative concept of "Negative Trust" - a term related to Zero Trust, yet one that can also function as an independent designation for a distinct paradigm. While initial attempts to define "Negative Trust" have been made - for instance, in the context of deception technology - a comprehensive scientific and interdisciplinary examination of the term, aimed at establishing it as a standalone, evolved IT security paradigm, has yet to be conducted. Ne-Trust addresses precisely this gap, creating an opportunity for the first-ever scientific exploration and development of "negative-trust" architectures. In doing so, the Cyber ​​Agency opens the door to novel and disruptive research perspectives, providing early impetus for the cybersecurity paradigms and IT security architectures of the future - and beyond. This forward-looking vision - along with the potential for a quantum leap in the defensive capabilities of IT systems and the comprehensive examination of conceptual, technological, social, and legal issues - underscores both the ambitious and the high-risk nature of this research program.

Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar twee fasen: 1. Instellingsfase 2. Gunningsfase Deze fasen worden nader uitgewerkt in vragenlijst 1.1. title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – DAS - Inhuur personeel - Koninklijke Marine (DAS-KM-3)
description: Omschrijving procedure Door middel van deze procedure stelt de Koninklijke Marine (KM) het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS-KM-3) in waarmee zij tijdelijke capaciteit en expertise gaat verwerven. Inhuur van personeel voor de betreffende categorieën zal in beginsel (behoudens lopende en nog af te sluiten raamovereenkomsten) via het DAS in de markt worden gezet. Hierop kan een uitzondering worden gemaakt indien het naar het oordeel van de KM noodzakelijk is om opdrachten op een andere manier te plaatsen. Bedrijfsprofiel De Directie Materiële Instandhouding (DMI), onderdeel van de KM, is verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud aan en de bevoorrading van het materieel voor het Ministerie van Defensie. Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Doelstelling Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De KM beoogt met het DAS op een eenvoudige wijze, snel de behoefte aan kennis en capaciteit met goed en gekwalificeerd personeel op te vullen. Wij willen daarom een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe laten. Op deze manier creëren wij optimale marktwerking, waarbij de wij uit een breed aanbod goed personeel kan selecteren voor de betreffende opdracht. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot een categorie houdt geen opdracht in; De KM plaats een nadere uitvraag in een categorie; Deelnemer schrijft in met kandida(a)t(en); De KM beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De looptijd is 48 maanden. De KM kan de looptijd met twee maal 48 maanden verlengen. Categorieën: De volgende categorieën zijn vooralsnog opgenomen: 1. Engineering Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Werktuigbouwkundige Electrotechnicus Scheepbouwkundige System Engineer Maintenance Engineer ILS-engineer Engineer E en WTB 2. Werkvoorbereiding & Planning Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Tekenaar/constructeur Werkvoorbereider Werkcoördinator Constructeur 3. Projectmanagement Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Projectmedewerker/ondersteuner/ Projectplanner Scheepscoördinator Projectmanager 4. Kwaliteitsmedewerkers Onder andere de volgende functies: Kwaliteitsengineer VKAM /KAM Toezichthouder Het staat de KM vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd functies en categorieën toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de KM waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

title: Iceland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – DPS for IT Consulting Services for NLSH
description: The New National Hospital (NLSH) project reg.nr. 500810-0410 hereby invite applicants to participate in this Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS): DPS for IT Consulting Services for NLSH. This DPS is divided into the following “lots”. Lot 1: IT Project Management. Lot 2: New Hospital IT projects. Lot 3: Closed Loop Medication Administration. Lot 4: LIMS systems. Lot 5: Modern EHR systems. Lot 6: Non - clinical supporting systems. Lot 7: ICT infrastructure of new hospital buildings. Lot 8: ICT integration. The Procurement process is established in accordance with the provisions of Article 41. Act no. 120/2016 on public procurement. All procurement within the DPS will be done by Closed tenders and all Participants that have been approved in accordance with the DPS documents will be invited to participate. Following individual procurement procedures, NLSH will enter a contract with one or more tenderers for specific categories of this DPS. All ITT´s are required to be advertised within the DPS for the minimum of 10 days. The purpose of this DPS is to able buyers and sellers to engage in commerce in a simpler way than before whereas technical or quality specification is described with each purchase. The time frame for procurements can be shorter than in more conventional process. NLSH in Reykjavik, Iceland, is the owner of this project and the Purchaser in this tender process. Further information on the New Hospital project can be found on the project website https://en.nlsh.is/ See technical specification/requirements specification.

title: Woodland Establishment across Scotland through a Dynamic Purchasing System
description: The Authority (FLS) has established a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Woodland Establishment across Scotland. FLS uses this system of pre-qualified suppliers to tender for Woodland Creation projects as and when they arise. title: Market research - AI Governance management
description: One of BR’s ambitions is to explore and responsibly harness the opportunities offered by artificial intelligence (AI). To ensure responsible use, and in view of BR’s duties as a public authority managing public information, sound governance of AI activities is essential. This includes robust procedures for ongoing assessments of risks, security, legislation and suppliers.To support this work, BR wishes to procure an AI governance tool. In 2024, a proof of concept (PoC) was conducted with the Finnish supplier Saidot. The PoC demonstrated the benefits of an AI governance tool for the agency by bringing all assessments together in one place.Much has changed since then. BR has procured a data and analytics platform from Google (Google Cloud Platform) and scaled up its AI activities. Various AI tools and opportunities are also being explored, creating a need for greater control and oversight.The purpose of this market survey is to identify AI governance solutions available on the market and determine how they support BR’s needs.

title: 69--CH-53E Containerized Flight Training Device (CFTD) Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) Pre-Solicitation Teleconference
description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. Prospective offerors are advised that the teleconference will be held solely for the purpose of explaining the FACE Technical Standard as it relates to this solicitation. All prospective offerors are advised that solicitation N61340-17-R-0035 will remain unchanged at the conclusion of the teleconference, unless this solicitation is amended in writing. If an amendment is issued, normal procedures relating to the acknowledgement and receipt of any such amendment shall be applicable. In no event, will failure to attend the conference constitute grounds for a claim after award of the delivery order. description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. Prospective offerors are advised that the teleconference will be held solely for the purpose of explaining the FACE Technical Standard as it relates to this solicitation. All prospective offerors are advised that solicitation N61340-17-R-0035 will remain unchanged at the conclusion of the teleconference, unless this solicitation is amended in writing. If an amendment is issued, normal procedures relating to the acknowledgement and receipt of any such amendment shall be applicable. In no event, will failure to attend the conference constitute grounds for a claim after award of the delivery order. title: Sonnet Software and Maintenance Support
description: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) intends to negotiate, on a sole source basis, under the authority of FAR 13.106-1(b) (1), with Sonnet Software, 126 N. Salina Street, Syracuse, NY 13202, for the Renewal of Sonnet software and Maintenance Support needed by NIST, Gaithersburg, Maryland. The Sole Source determination is based on the need to renew Sonnet Software and Maintenance Support, which is needed by the Research Facility Operations (RFO) at NIST. NIST currently has a license for the Sonnet platform by Sonnet Software and requires software support services to provide software license maintenance, security upgrades, and technical support for NIST Sonnet software packages. Replacing the software license with another product would result in the following: - Require the purchase of new start-up licenses of the competing product at approximately 4-5 times the cost of purchasing this maintenance and support. - Retraining all staff in the use of the replacement product. - Rewriting all the code written in this product in the format/language/syntax of the new product. Failure to renew Sonnet Software and support will prevent NIST from supporting the current version of the product as it becomes available, including IT security patches and updates. Additionally, NIST will not be able to open tickets for vendor support, and critical IT support will fail to function. Sonnet Software is the only known vendor capable of providing software licenses and maintenance support. The North American Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 513210 � Software Publishers. The small business size standard is $47.0 M. No solicitation package will be issued. title: Germany – Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing and security – Kommunikationsagentur für das Zentrum für Safe Sport (ZfSS)
description: Mit dem Zentrum für Safe Sport (nachfolgend bezeichnet als ZfSS) entsteht in Kassel erstmals eine unab-hängige Institution zur Prävention, Intervention und Aufarbeitung von interpersonaler Gewalt im deut-schen Sport. Als zentrale bundesweite Einrichtung soll das ZfSS einen sicheren und gewaltfreien Sport för-dern und wirksame Schutzstrukturen im deutschen Sport stärken. Aufgabe des ZfSS ist es, Vorfälle psychischer, physischer und sexualisierter Gewalt im Spitzensport – auch unterhalb der Strafbarkeits-schwelle – unabhängig von bestehenden Sportstrukturen und auf Grundlage einheitlicher Verfahrensstan-dards zu untersuchen und zu sanktionieren. Dieses Angebot wird sukzessive auf weitere Bereiche des or-gansierten Sports ausgeweitet. Daneben soll das ZfSS künftig auch Aufgaben in den Bereichen Prävention, Intervention und Aufarbeitung bündeln, Standards und Zertifizierungen für Safe Sport entwickeln und die Zusammenarbeit relevanter Akteure aus Sport, Wissenschaft, Politik und Zivilgesellschaft stärken. Das ZfSS wurde auf Grundlage eines gemeinsamen Beschlusses von Bund und Ländern in der Rechtsform eines gemeinnützigen Vereins im Juli gegründet und befindet sich derzeit im Aufbau, bevor es Mitte 2027 in den Regelbetrieb übergeht und erste Fälle untersucht werden können. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Beauftragung einer Kommunikationsagentur mit der Entwicklung und dem praktischen Aufbau eines initialen Markenauftritts für das Zentrum für Safe Sport (ZfSS), der Konzeption, Gestaltung und technischen Umsetzung eines ersten eigenständigen Webauftritts sowie der Unterstützung bei Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit einschließlich Social Media. Die Leistungen sollen die Aufbauphase des ZfSS unterstützen und eine tragfähige Grundlage für die weitere institutionelle Entwicklung und öffentliche Wahrnehmung schaffen. Der Auftrag umfasst sowohl einmalige initiale Leistungen als auch – nach Maßgabe der Vergabeunterlagen und des abzuschließenden Vertrags – laufende, optionale oder abrufbare Unterstützungsleistungen. Die Leistungserbringung gliedert sich in eine initiale Aufbauphase bis zum 30. April 2027 sowie eine anschließende Phase der laufenden Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung. Der Auftragnehmer erbringt die nachfolgend beschriebenen Leistungen. Die Leistungen sind in enger Kooperation mit dem Auftraggeber zu planen, abzustimmen, zu dokumentieren und nach Freigabe umzusetzen: 1. Entwicklung eines initialen Markenauftritts und einer initialen graphischen Linie einschließlich eines Logos, 2. Konzeption, Gestaltung, Realisierung und Betreuung eines ersten eigenständigen Web-Auftrittes für das ZfSS, 3. Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit einschließlich Social Media Auf Basis der Beistellungen vom Auftraggeber bereitet die Agentur die gelieferten Informationen zielgruppengerecht auf, pflegt sie in den digitalen Newsroom der Website ein und streut sie über die ausgewählten Social-Media-Kanäle. Sie erstellt daraus publikationsfähige Pressemitteilungen sowie ansprechende Posts und sorgt für eine technisch wie optisch einwandfreie Veröffentlichung. Die Leistungserbringung gliedert sich in eine initiale Aufbauphase bis zum 30. April 2027 sowie eine anschließende Phase der laufenden Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung. In der initialen Aufbauphase stehen insbesondere die in der Leistungsbeschreibung in den Ziffern 2.1 bis 2.3 beschriebenen initialen Liefergegenstände und der Aufbau der erforderlichen Kommunikationsstrukturen im Vordergrund. Nach Abschluss der initialen Aufbauphase erfolgen weitere Leistungen bedarfsgerecht auf Abruf innerhalb der vereinbarten Leistungskontingente und des Höchstauftragswertes. Der Vertragsgegenstand umfasst die in der Leistungsbeschreibung beschriebenen Leistungsbausteine 1 bis 3. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die Entwicklung des initialen Markenauftritts und der graphischen Linie, die Erstellung und Betreuung des Webauftritts sowie die Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit einschließlich Social Media. Die einzelnen Leistungen werden von der Auftraggeberin nach Bedarf und im Rahmen der vertraglich vereinbarten Höchstgrenze durch Einzelabruf in Textform beauftragt. Eine Verpflichtung zur Beauftragung oder Abnahme eines bestimmten Leistungsbausteins, einer bestimmten Anzahl von Arbeitstagen oder eines bestimmten Vergütungsvolumens besteht nicht.

Helsingin kaupunki vastaa Helsingin, Espoon, Vantaan ja Kauniaisten kaupunkien yhteisestä avoimen datan palvelusta Helsinki Region Infosharesta (HRI). Palvelun verkkosivusto on osoitteessa hri.fi. HRI-palvelu on perustettu vuonna 2011, ja sen nykyinen verkkosivusto on julkaistu vuonna 2018. Verkkopalvelu on HRI-palvelun viestinnällinen kanava. Siellä on datakatalogin ja sovellusgallerian lisäksi mm. pääkaupunkiseudun avoimeen dataan liittyviä blogikirjoituksia ja artikkeleja sekä ohjeita datan avaamiseen ja hyödyntämiseen. Tilaaja poistaa verkkopalvelussa tällä hetkellä (10/2026) olevat datakatalogin ja sovellusgallerian (ylävalikon Data- ja Sovellukset-osiot) ennen sopimuskauden alkua. Uusi datahaku sekä sovellusgalleria toteutetaan osana hankintaa. Palvelu otetaan käyttöön viimeistään neljän viikon kuluttua sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta. Palvelu on tarjottava suomen kielellä. Hankinnan kohde ja laajuus käy ilmi tarkemmin tarjouspyynnöstä ja sen liitteistä. Helsingin kaupunki ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin.,

title: Kommunikationsagentur für das Zentrum für Safe Sport (ZfSS)
description: Mit dem Zentrum für Safe Sport (nachfolgend bezeichnet als ZfSS) entsteht in Kassel erstmals eine unab-hängige Institution zur Prävention, Intervention und Aufarbeitung von interpersonaler Gewalt im deut-schen Sport. Als zentrale bundesweite Einrichtung soll das ZfSS einen sicheren und gewaltfreien Sport för-dern und wirksame Schutzstrukturen im deutschen Sport stärken. Aufgabe des ZfSS ist es, Vorfälle psychischer, physischer und sexualisierter Gewalt im Spitzensport – auch unterhalb der Strafbarkeits-schwelle – unabhängig von bestehenden Sportstrukturen und auf Grundlage einheitlicher Verfahrensstan-dards zu untersuchen und zu sanktionieren. Dieses Angebot wird sukzessive auf weitere Bereiche des or-gansierten Sports ausgeweitet. Daneben soll das ZfSS künftig auch Aufgaben in den Bereichen Prävention, Intervention und Aufarbeitung bündeln, Standards und Zertifizierungen für Safe Sport entwickeln und die Zusammenarbeit relevanter Akteure aus Sport, Wissenschaft, Politik und Zivilgesellschaft stärken. Das ZfSS wurde auf Grundlage eines gemeinsamen Beschlusses von Bund und Ländern in der Rechtsform eines gemeinnützigen Vereins im Juli gegründet und befindet sich derzeit im Aufbau, bevor es Mitte 2027 in den Regelbetrieb übergeht und erste Fälle untersucht werden können. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Beauftragung einer Kommunikationsagentur mit der Entwicklung und dem praktischen Aufbau eines initialen Markenauftritts für das Zentrum für Safe Sport (ZfSS), der Konzeption, Gestaltung und technischen Umsetzung eines ersten eigenständigen Webauftritts sowie der Unterstützung bei Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit einschließlich Social Media. Die Leistungen sollen die Aufbauphase des ZfSS unterstützen und eine tragfähige Grundlage für die weitere institutionelle Entwicklung und öffentliche Wahrnehmung schaffen. Der Auftrag umfasst sowohl einmalige initiale Leistungen als auch – nach Maßgabe der Vergabeunterlagen und des abzuschließenden Vertrags – laufende, optionale oder abrufbare Unterstützungsleistungen. Die Leistungserbringung gliedert sich in eine initiale Aufbauphase bis zum 30. April 2027 sowie eine anschließende Phase der laufenden Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung. Der Auftragnehmer erbringt die nachfolgend beschriebenen Leistungen. Die Leistungen sind in enger Kooperation mit dem Auftraggeber zu planen, abzustimmen, zu dokumentieren und nach Freigabe umzusetzen: 1. Entwicklung eines initialen Markenauftritts und einer initialen graphischen Linie einschließlich eines Logos, 2. Konzeption, Gestaltung, Realisierung und Betreuung eines ersten eigenständigen Web-Auftrittes für das ZfSS, 3. Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit einschließlich Social Media Auf Basis der Beistellungen vom Auftraggeber bereitet die Agentur die gelieferten Informationen zielgruppengerecht auf, pflegt sie in den digitalen Newsroom der Website ein und streut sie über die ausgewählten Social-Media-Kanäle. Sie erstellt daraus publikationsfähige Pressemitteilungen sowie ansprechende Posts und sorgt für eine technisch wie optisch einwandfreie Veröffentlichung. Die Leistungserbringung gliedert sich in eine initiale Aufbauphase bis zum 30. April 2027 sowie eine anschließende Phase der laufenden Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung. In der initialen Aufbauphase stehen insbesondere die in der Leistungsbeschreibung in den Ziffern 2.1 bis 2.3 beschriebenen initialen Liefergegenstände und der Aufbau der erforderlichen Kommunikationsstrukturen im Vordergrund. Nach Abschluss der initialen Aufbauphase erfolgen weitere Leistungen bedarfsgerecht auf Abruf innerhalb der vereinbarten Leistungskontingente und des Höchstauftragswertes. Der Vertragsgegenstand umfasst die in der Leistungsbeschreibung beschriebenen Leistungsbausteine 1 bis 3. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die Entwicklung des initialen Markenauftritts und der graphischen Linie, die Erstellung und Betreuung des Webauftritts sowie die Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit einschließlich Social Media. Die einzelnen Leistungen werden von der Auftraggeberin nach Bedarf und im Rahmen der vertraglich vereinbarten Höchstgrenze durch Einzelabruf in Textform beauftragt. Die Auftraggeberin ist berechtigt, einzelne Leistungsbausteine vollständig, teilweise oder überhaupt nicht abzurufen. Eine Verpflichtung zur Beauftragung oder Abnahme eines bestimmten Leistungsbausteins, einer bestimmten Anzahl von Arbeitstagen oder eines bestimmten Vergütungsvolumens besteht nicht.

title: Firefox
description: UPDATE: The purpose of Amendment 1 to DARPA-PA-26-137, the Firefox Program Solicitation (PS), is to update the deadlines for OPP submissions and presentations. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has developed a non-invasive coherent optical system capable of recording neural signals in humans. To expand this foundational technology and enable the development of revolutionary, non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), DARPA's Firefox program is soliciting approaches to overcome key technological hurdles: 1) development of components enabling dynamic rastering/scanning of the incoming coherent optical signal to target multiple regions of interest and 2) development of new data processing architectures beyond the digital domain to handle the high data rates and computational burden inherent to scaling the amount of neural data recorded by the optical system. The ultimate goal of the Firefox program is to use these innovations to develop a 100-channel, non-invasive BCI with 50-micron spatial and 100-microsecond temporal resolution.

title: 6810--501 - Dry Ice Base +4
description: The purpose of this amendment is to answer questions regarding Pre-solicitation Notice 36C26227Q0115. Q: Is 5/8 inch a strict nominal diameter, or is there an allowable tolerance? Would nominal 1/2-inch pellets be acceptable? A: 5/8 inch is preferred but 1/2 inch would be acceptable. No larger than 3/4 inch. Q: What documentation should offerors provide to demonstrate that the proposed container meets the stated specifications and the target of less than 8% sublimation loss per 24 hours? A: Manufacture documentation will be required. Q: The notice lists both 7:30 a.m. 3:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m. 3:30 p.m. Mountain Time. Which window applies to the receiving dock at 2401 Centre Ave SE? A: 7:30 am 3:00 pm MT Q: Would the VA accept two insulated containers containing 300 lbs each, for a combined weekly delivery of 600 lbs, instead of a single container with a minimum capacity of 700 lbs? A: The weekly delivery must be at least 550lbs and no more than 600lbs in a single container. Q: Would the VA accept weekly deliveries on Thursdays or Fridays instead of Mondays, provided we consistently deliver the required 600 lbs? Thursday would be our preferred delivery day, subject to confirmation of our ability to maintain that schedule. A: Thursday/Friday delivery will lead to excess waste and will not be appropriate for the hospital s scheduled send-outs. Q: Could you confirm whether November 26, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Pacific is the deadline for responding to the pre-solicitation or for submitting a formal quote? Please also let us know where the solicitation and submission instructions will be available. A: The date and time, extended to Monday, November 30, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time, is the deadline for responding to the pre-solicitation notice and expressing interest in the requirement. It is not the deadline for submission of a formal quote. The Government intends to issue the solicitation directly to vendors determined capable of meeting the requirement based on: Vendors identified through market research. Vendors known to carry the required product. Vendors capable of meeting delivery requirements. Vendors that satisfy the socioeconomic requirement. Past performance. Price. Q: Should each annual CLIN be quoted as a single delivered price per pound that includes delivery, fuel, hazmat fees, and container exchange? A: Yes. Q: Will a supplier's weight ticket be sufficient to verify the 600-pound net delivery, or does the receiving team weigh it on site? A: Weight tickets will be sufficient. Q: Should the driver exchange containers at the dock or move them to a designated storage area? How should the driver handle any dry ice remaining in the previous container? A: Any remaining dry ice from previous deliveries will be transferred before exchanges, which will occur at the dock. Receiving personnel will move the deliveries to the storage area. Q: Does SBA's class waiver of the nonmanufacturer rule for industrial gases (NAICS 325120, PSC 6810) apply to this requirement, or must the dry ice be produced by a small business manufacturer? A: The nonmanufacturer rule will apply to this requirement. Q: May the contractor's supplier own the insulated storage containers and swap them at each weekly delivery? A: Yes. Q: Can invoicing occur weekly? A: Invoices will need to be submitted monthly, in arrears.

description: The Defense Logistics Agency is issuing a solicitation for a national requirements contract for Epinephrine Injectors. Procurement details follow. Epinephrine 0.3 MG/0.3 ML Injection, Auto-Injector 2S in 2 count bottles. This will be an unrestricted and fully competitive acquisition. The contract will be a firm-fixed price, requirements type contract with a one-year base and four one-year options. A contract resulting from this solicitation will establish a national supply source, in accordance with FAR 52.216-21 (Requirements), to provide the items listed in the schedule for purchase by Department of Defense, Department of Veterans Affairs, Indian Health Service and Bureau of Prisons customers through the DLA and VA prime vendor programs. The annual usage estimates will be provided in the Schedule of Supplies section of the solicitation. This is a commercial item and will be solicited using FAR part 12. All sources may submit a proposal which shall be considered by the agency. A copy of the solicitation will be posted to the DLA Bid Board System (DIBBS) at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil and Sam.Gov at https://sam.gov. Interested parties should contact Jeremy Brown at (445) 737-5419, (jeremy.brown@dla.mil) for any questions/comments. Interested parties are further advised to set up automated notifications of pre-solicitation or solicitation changes through this website. The current solicitation date is October of 2026.

The scope of effort under this IDIQ contract will include performing scheduled and unscheduled depot tasks, within-scope repairs, in-service repairs, light planeside manufacturing and fabrication, and modification to airframe structures and aircraft systems per NAVAIR issued E-6B Technical Directives and E-6B depot technical manuals. To the largest degree possible, the Bill of Material parts to support the effort herein will be supplied by the E-6B Contractor Logistics Support (CLS) provider from stock that is owned by the E-6B program. title: NATO Business Opportunity: Integration and Commissioning of the RAVEN Initial Capability
description: The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) intends to issue a solicitation for the commissioning, initial configuration of the networking part of the CIS codenamed RAVEN, including staging equipment and transport cases. RAVEN will provide highly available and resilient services, such as communications, collaboration and printing for end users. Potential U.S. prime contractors must 1) maintain a professionally active facility (office, factory, laboratory, etc.) within the United States, 2) be pre-approved for participation in NATO Competitive Procurement (NCP), 4) be issued a Declaration of Eligibility (DOE) by the Department of Commerce (DOC), and 5) register with NCIA�s eProcurement tool, Neo: https://www.ncia.nato.int/business/procurement/neo-eprocurement The reference for the solicitation is NCP-CO-424384-RAVEN and all correspondence concerning the solicitation should include this reference. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT Objective: RAVEN will implement communication kits consisting of portable communication equipment (over multiple separated domains), initial equipment configuration, printing capabilities and transport cases. This initial RAVEN scope will be limited to thirty-three (33) kits. The provision of further kits, with quantities also evolving over time, will be covered under other follow-on projects under the same overarching program. Scope: Thirty-three kits, consisting of networking equipment, printing equipment, all required transport cases, and the staging equipment. Together with this, voice and VTC equipment might be required as an option. The capability will be implemented in accordance with an existing High-Level Design (HLD), which is derived from an interim CIS design and Security Architecture (iCDSA). The iCDSA forms the basis for Security Accreditation. Any physical room or static facilities where installation might have to be done, will be provided as PFI. They will be provided with all the power, cooling, rack space, desk space and associated furniture, and physical security required for the installation. A detailed description of them will also be provided to the successful Bidder as PFI. Site Surveys will be conducted following Contract Award, as required. The scope of the works in this procurement includes, but it is not limited to: 1) the production of the low-level design (LLD) and initial configuration, based on the PFI; 2) the commissioning and provisioning of all required RAVEN CIS and non-CIS equipment, as fully functional; 3) the system commissioning activities, i.e. testing and verification, security accreditation, and operational acceptance. Key Deliverables: The key deliverables of this procurement are: � The first thirty-three (33) communication kits of the RAVEN solution, integrated and operational using the initial configuration; This entails a modular deployable communication edge system, including all necessary networking devices; � All required transport cases and printing devices; � All the Technical Management and Engineering efforts required for the successful integration and commissioning of the above; � All the associated documentation, e.g. the Low-Level Design (LLD) and the As-Built documentation, ILS documentation, etc, including the initial configuration; � All the required Project Management efforts for the successful integration and commissioning to occur in the contractual time, cost and scope; � All the required Quality Assurance Management efforts to guarantee the highest quality standards in the delivered capability; � Optional: VTC and secure voice devices, as per provided design and requirements. BECOMING ELIGIBLE TO BID NCP requires that the U.S. Government issue a DOE for potential U.S. prime contractors interested in this project. Before the U.S. Government can do so, however, the U.S. Government must approve the U.S. firm for participation in NCP. U.S. firms are approved for NCP on a facility-by-facility basis. The U.S. NCP application is a one-time application. The application requires supporting documentation in the form of 1) a company resume or capability statement indicating contracts completed as a prime contractor and 2) an annual report or set of financial documents indicating compilation, review, or audit by an independent CPA. The U.S. Government continues to accept the legacy NATO International Competitive Bidding (ICB) application for participation in NCP. U.S. firms can download a copy of the legacy ICB application from the following website: https://www.bis.gov/about-bis/bis-leadership-and-offices/SIES/business-opportunities-nato DOC is the U.S. Government agency that approves NCP applications. Please submit to the email address provided your application and supporting documentation (as attachments). If your firm is interested in a specific NCP project at this time, please also include the following in the TEXT of your email: - the title and/or solicitation number of the project - the name/phone/email of the company employee who should receive the bid documents After approval of your one-time NCP application, DOC will then know to follow up by issuing a DOE for the project. DOC will transmit the DOE to the NATO contracting agency. IMPORTANT DATES: Request a DOE (and, for firms new to NCP, submit the one-time NCP application): 30 November 2026 NCIA releases the solicitation (planned): 21 December 2026 Bid closing (anticipated): 17 February 2027 Contract Award (estimated): 31 May 2027

title: Denmark – Printing services – Produktion, distribution og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og det blå EU-sygesikringskort
description: Amgros I/S (Amgros) er et interessentskab med de fem regioner. Amgros gennemfører udbuddet som indkøbscentral, indgår kontrakten med den vindende tilbudsgiver og varetager den efterfølgende kontraktstyring. Regionerne og Udbetaling Danmark er aftagere under kontrakten og afholder betalingen for deres respektive aftag. Udbuddet vedrører en samlet løsning for produktion herunder indkøb og håndtering af materialer, trykning, pakning, frankering og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og EU-sygesikringskort. Kontrakten omfatter en implementeringsperiode bl.a. fastlæggelse af kortenes design, etablering af nødvendige IT-integrationer samt gennemførelse af relevante test og prøver. Fra driftsdagen d. 1. april 2027, skal leverandøren på baggrund af modtagne bestillinger producere, distribuere og levere kortene til modtageradresser i Danmark og resten af verden. På baggrund af det historiske forbrug forventes et årligt aftag på ca. 3 mio. kort. Det faktiske aftag kan variere og kan afvige fra det forventede årlig aftag med +/- 30 %.
